description: This file defines a question generator agent as part of a larger system for medical exam preparation. It uses LangGraph workflows for question creation, validation, and citation addition. It includes classes for state management and methods for generating questions both individually and in bulk, with logic for validation and regeneration.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema for the state of the question generation workflow.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflows, validation, and batch processing.

methods.name: StateGraph _build_graph(self)
methods.description: Builds the LangGraph workflow with nodes and conditional edges for question generation.

methods.name: str _should_regenerate(self, state: QuestionState)
methods.description: Determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempts.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] generate_single_question( self, chapter_id: int, difficulty: str = "intermediate", include_images: bool = False )
methods.description: Asynchronously generates one question for a given chapter and difficulty, with optional images.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] generate_batch_questions( self, chapter_id: int, count: int, difficulty: str = "intermediate", include_images: bool = False, max_concurrent: int = 3 )
methods.description: Generates multiple questions concurrently using batching.
